name: Design Your Neighborhood
what_you_do: Work with design pros to fix up a real space in your community. Learn about art, buildings, city plans, parks, rooms and fashion. Visit design firms and make a final project.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 10 to 12. Each summer SAM works with one community group that serves young people, so spots go through that year's partner.
pay_detail: The page says it is a paid opportunity but does not give the amount.
duration: Four weeks in August. Exact dates depend on the project and partner.
deadline_text: No 2027 dates or partner are posted.
how_to_apply: The page does not explain how a student signs up. Email teenprograms@seattleartmuseum.org to ask about the next summer's partner.
notes: Past projects redid the South Park Community Center teen room and a school computer lab. If you are paid as an employee, ask whether you need Washington parent and school papers for a minor.
